verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵ֛י מ֥וֹת מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֔וּן מְשָׁרֵ֥ת מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê mō·wṯ mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ Yah·weh way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn mə·šā·rêṯ mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Now after the death of His servant Moses the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun Moses’ assistant saying
verses.literalPt: E SUCEDEU depois da morte de Moisés, servo do SENHOR, que o SENHOR falou a Josué, filho de Num, servo de Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדִּ֖י מֵ֑ת וְעַתָּה֩ ק֨וּם עֲבֹ֜ר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֣ן הַזֶּ֗ה אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ‘aḇ·dî mêṯ wə·‘at·tāh qūm ‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên haz·zeh ’at·tāh wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî nō·ṯên lā·hem liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Moses My servant is dead Now therefore arise you and all these people and cross over the Jordan - into the land that I am giving to the children of Israel
verses.literalPt: Moisés, meu servo, é morto; levanta-te, pois, agora, passa este Jordão, tu e todo este povo, à terra que eu dou aos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: כָּל־ מָק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּדְרֹ֧ךְ כַּֽף־ רַגְלְכֶ֛ם בּ֖וֹ לָכֶ֣ם נְתַתִּ֑יו כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer tiḏ·rōḵ kap̄- raḡ·lə·ḵem bōw lā·ḵem nə·ṯat·tîw ka·’ă·šer dib·bar·tî ’el- mō·šeh
verses.literal: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread just as I promised to Moses
verses.literalPt: Todo o lugar que pisar a planta do vosso pé, vo-lo tenho dado, como eu disse a Moisés.

verses.original: מֵהַמִּדְבָּר֩ וְהַלְּבָנ֨וֹן הַזֶּ֜ה וְֽעַד־ הַנָּהָ֧ר הַגָּד֣וֹל נְהַר־ פְּרָ֗ת כֹּ֚ל אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחִתִּ֔ים וְעַד־ הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל מְב֣וֹא הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ יִֽהְיֶ֖ה גְּבוּלְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mê·ham·miḏ·bār wə·hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn haz·zeh wə·‘aḏ- han·nā·hār hag·gā·ḏō·wl nə·har- pə·rāṯ kōl ’e·reṣ ha·ḥit·tîm wə·‘aḏ- hay·yām hag·gā·ḏō·wl mə·ḇō·w haš·šā·meš yih·yeh gə·ḇū·lə·ḵem
verses.literal: Your territory shall extend from the wilderness and Lebanon . . . to the great River Euphrates all the land of the Hittites and west . . . as far as the Great Sea
verses.literalPt: Desde o deserto e do Líbano, até ao grande rio, o rio Eufrates, toda a terra dos heteus, e até o grande mar para o poente do sol, será o vosso termo.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִישׁ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיִ֤יתִי עִם־ מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א אַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א אֶעֶזְבֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ’îš lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā kōl yə·mê ḥay·ye·ḵā ka·’ă·šer hā·yî·ṯî ‘im- mō·šeh ’eh·yeh ‘im·māḵ lō ’ar·pə·ḵā wə·lō ’e·‘ez·ḇe·kā
verses.literal: No one shall stand against you all the days of your life As I was with Moses so will I be with you I will never leave you nor forsake you
verses.literalPt: Ninguém te poderá resistir, todos os dias da tua vida; como fui com Moisés, assim serei contigo; não te deixarei nem te desampararei.

verses.original: חֲזַ֖ק וֶאֱמָ֑ץ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תַּנְחִיל֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶת־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·zaq we·’ĕ·māṣ kî ’at·tāh tan·ḥîl ’eṯ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘·tî la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem
verses.literal: Be strong and courageous for you shall give these people the inheritance - . . . of the land that I swore to their fathers I would give them
verses.literalPt: Esforça-te, e tem bom ânimo; porque tu farás a este povo herdar a terra que jurei a seus pais lhes daria.

verses.original: רַק֩ חֲזַ֨ק וֶֽאֱמַ֜ץ מְאֹ֗ד לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ כְּכָל־ הַתּוֹרָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוְּךָ֙ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדִּ֔י אַל־ תָּס֥וּר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול לְמַ֣עַן תַּשְׂכִּ֔יל בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: raq ḥă·zaq we·’ĕ·maṣ mə·’ōḏ liš·mōr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kə·ḵāl- hat·tō·w·rāh ’ă·šer ṣiw·wə·ḵā mō·šeh ‘aḇ·dî ’al- tā·sūr mim·men·nū yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl lə·ma·‘an taś·kîl bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer tê·lêḵ
verses.literal: Above all be strong and very courageous Be careful to observe all the law that My servant Moses commanded you Do not turn from it to the right or to the left so that you may prosper wherever . . . you go
verses.literalPt: Tão-somente esforça-te e tem mui bom ânimo, para teres o cuidado de fazer conforme a toda a lei que meu servo Moisés te ordenou; dela não te desvies, nem para a direita nem para a esquerda, para que prudentemente te conduzas por onde quer que andares.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יָמ֡וּשׁ סֵפֶר֩ הַתּוֹרָ֨ה הַזֶּ֜ה מִפִּ֗יךָ וְהָגִ֤יתָ בּוֹ֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה לְמַ֙עַן֙ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּכָל־ הַכָּת֖וּב בּ֑וֹ כִּי־ אָ֛ז תַּצְלִ֥יחַ אֶת־ דְּרָכֶ֖ךָ וְאָ֥ז תַּשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yā·mūš sê·p̄er hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zeh mip·pî·ḵā wə·hā·ḡî·ṯā bōw yō·w·mām wā·lay·lāh lə·ma·‘an tiš·mōr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kə·ḵāl- hak·kā·ṯūḇ bōw kî- ’āz taṣ·lî·aḥ ’eṯ- də·rā·ḵe·ḵā wə·’āz taś·kîl
verses.literal: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth meditate on it day and night so that you may be careful to do everything written in it For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do . . .
verses.literalPt: Não se aparte da tua boca o livro desta lei; antes medita nele dia e noite, para que tenhas cuidado de fazer conforme a tudo quanto nele está escrito; porque então farás prosperar o teu caminho, e serás bem sucedido.

verses.original: הֲל֤וֹא צִוִּיתִ֙יךָ֙ חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָ֔ץ אַֽל־ תַּעֲרֹ֖ץ וְאַל־ תֵּחָ֑ת כִּ֤י עִמְּךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּלֵֽךְ׃פ
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ṣiw·wî·ṯî·ḵā ḥă·zaq we·’ĕ·māṣ ’al- ta·‘ă·rōṣ wə·’al- tê·ḥāṯ kî ‘im·mə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer tê·lêḵ
verses.literal: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous Do not be afraid . . . do not be discouraged for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go
verses.literalPt: Não to mandei eu? Esforça-te, e tem bom ânimo; não temas, nem te espantes; porque o SENHOR teu Deus é contigo, por onde quer que andares.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ אֶת־ שֹׁטְרֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.literal: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people . . .
verses.literalPt: Então Josué deu ordem aos príncipes do povo, dizendo:

verses.original: עִבְר֣וּ׀ בְּקֶ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֗ה וְצַוּ֤וּ אֶת־ הָעָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הָכִ֥ינוּ לָכֶ֖ם צֵידָ֑ה כִּ֞י בְּע֣וֹד׀ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים אַתֶּם֙ עֹֽבְרִים֙ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֣ן הַזֶּ֔ה לָבוֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘iḇ·rū bə·qe·reḇ ham·ma·ḥă·neh wə·ṣaw·wū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām lê·mōr hā·ḵî·nū lā·ḵem ṣê·ḏāh kî bə·‘ō·wḏ šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm ’at·tem ‘ō·ḇə·rîm ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên haz·zeh lā·ḇō·w lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem nō·ṯên lā·ḵem lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: Go through the camp and tell the people . . . Prepare your provisions for within three days you will cross the Jordan to go in and take possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess
verses.literalPt: Passai pelo meio do arraial e ordenai ao povo, dizendo: Provede-vos de comida, porque dentro de três dias passareis este Jordão, para que entreis a possuir a terra que vos dá o SENHOR vosso Deus, para a possuirdes.

verses.original: וְלָרֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְלַגָּדִ֔י וְלַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֑ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî wə·lag·gā·ḏî wə·la·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ ham·naš·šeh ’ā·mar yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ lê·mōr
verses.literal: But to the Reubenites the Gadites and the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh Joshua . . . said
verses.literalPt: E falou Josué aos rubenitas, e aos gaditas, e à meia tribo de Manassés, dizendo:

verses.original: זָכוֹר֙ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֥ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֙ מֵנִ֣יחַ לָכֶ֔ם וְנָתַ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: zā·ḵō·wr ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh ’eṯ·ḵem mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ- Yah·weh lê·mōr Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem mê·nî·aḥ lā·ḵem wə·nā·ṯan lā·ḵem ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: Remember - what Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you when he said The LORD your God will give you rest and He will give you this land
verses.literalPt: Lembrai-vos da palavra que vos mandou Moisés, o servo do SENHOR, dizendo: O SENHOR vosso Deus vos dá descanso, e vos dá esta terra.

verses.original: נְשֵׁיכֶ֣ם טַפְּכֶם֮ וּמִקְנֵיכֶם֒ יֵשְׁב֕וּ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֥ן לָכֶ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְאַתֶּם֩ תַּעַבְר֨וּ חֲמֻשִׁ֜ים לִפְנֵ֣י אֲחֵיכֶ֗ם כֹּ֚ל גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַחַ֔יִל וַעֲזַרְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: nə·šê·ḵem ṭap·pə·ḵem ū·miq·nê·ḵem yê·šə·ḇū bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·ṯan lā·ḵem mō·šeh bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên wə·’at·tem ta·‘aḇ·rū ḥă·mu·šîm lip̄·nê ’ă·ḥê·ḵem kōl gib·bō·w·rê ha·ḥa·yil wa·‘ă·zar·tem ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Your wives your young children and your livestock may remain in the land that Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan . . . But all your mighty men of valor must be armed for battle to cross over ahead of your brothers and help them
verses.literalPt: Vossas mulheres, vossos meninos e vosso gado fiquem na terra que Moisés vos deu deste lado do Jordão; porém vós passareis armados na frente de vossos irmãos, todos os valentes e valorosos, e ajudá-los-eis;

verses.original: עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁר־ יָנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֥ה׀ לַֽאֲחֵיכֶם֮ כָּכֶם֒ וְיָרְשׁ֣וּ גַם־ הֵ֔מָּה אֶת־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם וְשַׁבְתֶּ֞ם לְאֶ֤רֶץ יְרֻשַּׁתְכֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אוֹתָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֗ם מֹשֶׁה֙ עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֔ה בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרַ֥ח הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- yā·nî·aḥ Yah·weh la·’ă·ḥê·ḵem kā·ḵem wə·yā·rə·šū ḡam- hêm·māh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem nō·ṯên lā·hem wə·šaḇ·tem lə·’e·reṣ yə·ruš·šaṯ·ḵem wî·riš·tem ’ō·w·ṯāh ’ă·šer nā·ṯan lā·ḵem mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ Yah·weh bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên miz·raḥ haš·šā·meš
verses.literal: until the LORD gives them rest . . . as He has done for you and your brothers also possess the land that the LORD your God is giving them Then you may return to the land of your inheritance and take possession of that which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the east . . . side of the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Até que o SENHOR dê descanso a vossos irmãos, como a vós, e eles também possuam a terra que o SENHOR vosso Deus lhes dá; então tornareis à terra da vossa herança, e possuireis a que vos deu Moisés, o servo do SENHOR, deste lado do Jordão, para o nascente do sol.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲנ֔וּ אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוִּיתָ֙נוּ֙ נַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְאֶֽל־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּשְׁלָחֵ֖נוּ נֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·nū ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ lê·mōr kōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wî·ṯā·nū na·‘ă·śeh wə·’el- kāl- ’ă·šer tiš·lā·ḥê·nū nê·lêḵ
verses.literal: So they answered Joshua . . . Everything you have commanded us we will do and everywhere . . . you send us we will go
verses.literalPt: Então responderam a Josué, dizendo: Tudo quanto nos ordenaste faremos, e onde quer que nos enviares iremos.

verses.original: כְּכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁמַ֙עְנוּ֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֖ן נִשְׁמַ֣ע אֵלֶ֑יךָ רַ֠ק יִֽהְיֶ֞ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה עִם־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- šā·ma‘·nū ’el- mō·šeh kên niš·ma‘ ’ê·le·ḵā raq yih·yeh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ‘im·māḵ ka·’ă·šer hā·yāh ‘im- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Just as we obeyed . . . . . . Moses . . . in all things so we will obey you . . . And may the LORD your God be with you as He was with Moses
verses.literalPt: Como em tudo ouvimos a Moisés, assim te ouviremos a ti, tão-somente que o SENHOR teu Deus seja contigo, como foi com Moisés.

verses.original: כָּל־ אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יַמְרֶ֣ה אֶת־ פִּ֗יךָ וְלֹֽא־ יִשְׁמַ֧ע אֶת־ דְּבָרֶ֛יךָ לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ תְּצַוֶּ֖נּוּ יוּמָ֑ת רַ֖ק חֲזַ֥ק וֶאֱמָֽץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’îš ’ă·šer- yam·reh ’eṯ- pî·ḵā wə·lō- yiš·ma‘ ’eṯ- də·ḇā·re·ḵā lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- tə·ṣaw·wen·nū yū·māṯ raq ḥă·zaq we·’ĕ·māṣ
verses.literal: Anyone . . . who rebels against your order and does not obey your words all that you command him will be put to death Above all be strong and courageous
verses.literalPt: Todo o homem, que for rebelde às tuas ordens, e não ouvir as tuas palavras em tudo quanto lhe mandares, morrerá. Tão-somente esforça-te, e tem bom ânimo.
